cards.review_notes: Confirm the 2026 or 2027 camp details and drop-off location directly with the church. The only readable official camp text is for 2025 and lists registration for Pre-K and rising kindergarten, and rising first grade and up; those historical grade bands were not assigned to 2026 or 2027. The church site did not expose registration destinations or embedded camp details. The day format and church venue remain only partly supported.
